classification.difficultyReason: Find an included angle from three sides, then use that angle to calculate the area.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with A lower left, B above and C lower right; ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: AB=6 cm, BC=8 cm, AC=12 cm. No angle values or extra marks are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: All three side lengths and vertex labels are permanent question givens.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use the cosine rule to find $\angle BAC$, correct to one decimal place.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of the triangle, correct to the nearest square centimetre.

answer.worked:
Using the unrounded angle from part a:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Area}&=\frac12\times6\times12\times\sin\!\left(\cos^{-1}\!\frac{29}{36}\right)\\\text{Area}&=\sqrt{455}\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Area}&\approx21\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
